sections.description: Visual Designer Manager V3 med V1 som funktionel og visuel reference.
sections.changelog: 3.0.0-alpha.25: Mobile Natural Flow Reset. V1-converted sections/containers now reset desktop grid rows and fixed/min heights by ID, Header wrappers are flattened into one vertically centered flex row, spacers stop owning mobile spacing, Footer grid height inheritance is reset, and theme-color is #30382a. Alpha.24 V1 spacing/hero/card fixes and Alpha.22 menu behavior are preserved.
